period: 311 'Vacnt Bldg Unsecured' filed 1 Jan 2024 to 14 Jul 2026 (90 days of follow-up)
definition: Vacant building unsecured, closed 'referred to board up crew': share with a board-up recorded at the same address within the 14-day promise.
label: observed
note: n = 2,437; median 3.7 days to close in 311; boarded within 30 days 36%, within 90 days 71%; median 34.5 days to board-up where one exists. Comparison: closures saying no violation etc. 19% within 90 days. Address match, board-up layer maps8_BUILDING_DIVISION_Boardups (DateBoardedUp). Chronic sites: 33% had a board-up 30 to 365 days before filing.
derivation: 311 service requests (city open data, csb.zip yearly CSVs 2024-2026; invalid UTF-8 bytes dropped with iconv -c), reduced to one row per REQUESTID because the CSV repeats a request once per caller. 'Vacant building unsecured' requests joined to the Building Division's board-up layer (city ArcGIS maps8 BUILDING_DIVISION Boardups, DateBoardedUp) by normalised street address; the first board-up from one day before filing counts. Board-ups recur at the same buildings, so a later board-up need not answer this request.
